references.observed: Wide night aerial distinguishes the main plant, guide islands and separate locks.
Daylight aerial shows Lock 1’s chamber and gate towers, main spillway, two powerhouse sections, divider walls and red gantries.
Operator procurement notice records the 27, 9 and 6 gate groups and their bay and sill dimensions.
Operator navigation guide distinguishes all three locks.
Operator lists a 70 m crest, 66 m upstream design stage and 39 m minimum navigable downstream stage.
Water reference records a 2606.5 m crossing.
October 2026 notice records the start of Lock 3 expansion and closure of the original lock. Future works are outside the fixture.
The standard crest road, two powerhouse wings and three named ship-lock axes define the signed model frame.
